capabilities: Rotate a daily Danish word selected deterministically by date
Play Danish pronunciation MP3s and locally generated example-sentence audio
Filter the 4442-word deck by CEFR level (A1-C2)
Navigate the deck and mark words as starred or mastered
Download missing pronunciation audio on demand from GitHub
extras: Audio files are not bundled with the release; they are downloaded on demand from GitHub, which requires an internet connection on first use. Developer scripts for batch audio generation and Chinese gloss import are documented in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in vocabulary or language-learning tool, so Danish learners must study word lists in a separate flashcard app.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin built on the Anki Danish frequency deck (DDO Danish Frequency Deck).
This plugin was inspired by ankidkdeck v2.0 (iskoldt-X/ankidkdeck).

summary: Daily Danish vocabulary plugin that shows a word-of-the-day card with English and Chinese glosses, example sentences, and pronunciation audio.
